response.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_fill) AS result FROM (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark WHERE CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow) g WHERE g.avg_fill IS NOT NULL
